2609.02746.title: HiPoly: a hierarchical polymer-native AI framework for property prediction and generative design
2609.02746.paper_summary: Polymeric materials are central to modern technologies, with applications ranging from energy to health and transportation. Although AI has made significant advances in materials discovery, the hierarchical structure of polymers across multiple length scales makes them inherently difficult to represent in a unified and physically meaningful way. Here we introduce HiPoly, a polymer-native AI framework that processes complete polymer descriptions through a three-level hierarchical graph architecture built on the G2RINS representation. HiPoly encodes stochastic inter-monomer connectivity, composition, and molecular weight directly within its architecture, using physically motivated design principles that mirror the multi-scale nature of polymeric systems. The framework establishes an end-to-end AI-driven workflow from experimental formulation data to property prediction, generative molecular design, and physics-based validation through molecular simulations, all unified by a single polymer representation. We demonstrate state-of-the-art prediction accuracy for thermophysical properties of multi-component polymer systems, with ablation studies confirming that each hierarchical design choice contributes independently to model performance. As an example, the generative design pathway is applied here to the discovery of sustainable alternatives to persistent fluorinated polymers, where it is possible to identify and independently validate PFAS-free candidates with target surface-energy properties. This work demonstrates how polymer-native AI can accelerate discovery by linking representation, prediction, and design across complex polymer chemistries.
2609.02746.paper_summary_zh: 聚合材料是現代技術的核心，應用範圍從能源到健康和交通。儘管人工智慧在材料發現方面取得了重大進展，但聚合物在多個長度尺度上的層次結構使其本質上難以以統一且物理上有意義的方式進行表示。在此，我們介紹 HiPoly，一個聚合物原生的人工智慧框架，通過基於 G2RINS 表示的三層層次圖架構處理完整的聚合物描述。HiPoly 在其架構中直接編碼隨機的單體間連接性、組成和分子量，使用反映聚合物系統多尺度特性的物理驅動設計原則。該框架建立了一個端到端的人工智慧驅動工作流程，從實驗配方數據到性質預測、生成分子設計及通過分子模擬的基於物理的驗證，所有這些都由單一的聚合物表示統一。我們展示了對多組分聚合物系統的熱物理性質的最先進預測準確性，消融研究確認每個層次設計選擇獨立地對模型性能作出貢獻。作為一個例子，這裡應用生成設計途徑來發現持久氟化聚合物的可持續替代品，在這裡可以識別並獨立驗證具有目標表面能特性的無 PFAS 候選者。這項工作展示了聚合物原生人工智慧如何通過連結表示、預測和設計來加速發現，跨越複雜的聚合物化學。
